extracted.intended_audience: public relations and communications professionals, marketers, and organizations issuing press releases
extracted.subtask_short: writing press releases and PR strategy
extracted.subtask_description: High-level guidance and criteria for producing effective public relations content (including press releases, multimedia PR, investor relations and content marketing), with emphasis on audience relevance, content strategy, and adapting to digital/social channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement over raw audience size
rubrics_metrics.description: "Effective PR Isn't About Eyeballs - It's About Engagement" / Establishing a relevant connection with your audience is the key to success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on creating relevant connections with target audiences rather than maximizing impressions alone; prioritize engagement metrics and meaningful interactions as measures of PR success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content-as-currency / content-driven marketing
rubrics_metrics.description: "Marketing Is Content" / Increasingly, content is the currency that drives brand engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop valuable, shareable content to drive brand engagement across channels; treat content creation and distribution as central to PR and marketing strategies rather than secondary activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optimize press releases for search engines (Press Release SEO)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Press Release SEO: Writing Press Releases Effectively for Search Engines" (listed as a featured/most viewed resource).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When issuing news releases, apply SEO best practices so releases are discoverable online. Use relevant keywords, clear headlines, and formatting that supports search visibility (detailed tactics referenced in the linked resource).

rubrics_metrics.name: Adapt communications to interactive and digital media
rubrics_metrics.description: "The principles of strong communications haven’t changed, but the way campaigns are executed is evolving in the new media age. Interactive media is leveling the playing field and the rules of success are still emerging."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design campaigns with digital and interactive channels in mind; be prepared to evolve tactics as new platforms and audience behaviors emerge. Emphasize two-way engagement and platform-appropriate content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage multimedia & broadcast PR channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Knowledge Center includes a category for "Multimedia & Broadcast PR" indicating use of multimedia formats as part of PR strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate multimedia assets (video, audio, images) and broadcast-oriented tactics where appropriate to increase reach and storytelling impact; tailor multimedia to distribution channels and audience expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use case studies and white papers to demonstrate effectiveness and thought leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Featured content includes white papers (e.g., "PR Rising", "Marketing Is Content") and case studies (e.g., Salvation Army case study) as resources for learning and demonstrating PR outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce and reference white papers and case studies to support strategy, show measurable results, and position organizations as thought leaders; use them to inform campaign design and to persuade stakeholders.
